_comment: Authoritative choreography for IMG_3775.mov, in VIDEO SECONDS, built from
frame-annotated review (the top-left clock). Every jump and dodge below is
predetermined: it happens at exactly `time` on every playthrough. Player
input only scores - a press inside the window clears, otherwise the ball
flashes red and the motion happens anyway. type `hop` is a small automatic
believability hop (a level change, a kerb) that is never cued or scored.
`time` is the takeoff; `airTime` is takeoff-to-landing; `height` is the arc
peak in frame heights. Takeoffs and air times are sized against the frames
themselves: the rule is that no frame of an arc may show the ball
overlapping the obstacle it clears - which is why several takeoffs sit
earlier than the obstacle reaching the ball (the van's hood arrives at the
column before the annotated moment) and several arcs outlast the
obstacle's whole crossing (the parked car crosses the old landing spot).
Scoring windows and warning leads are derived from the gaps between scored
events at authoring time; hops are invisible to that derivation.

events.label: car
events._why: the car crosses the old landing spot until ~8.5s; landing at 8.61 is the first clear ground, and the same arc carries the rail-to-road drop

events.label: van (whole)
events._why: the van's hood reaches the column at ~9.7, before the annotated 9.94 - takeoff must beat it; landing 11.55 right after the tail is annotated exact

events.label: suv
events._why: annotated landing on the sidewalk at 18.62

events.label: people
events._why: the group is nearly frame-tall; the first woman crosses at 23.65 and the tall man at 24.35-24.6, so the arc peak is centred on him and takeoff beats her - measured frame by frame for zero overlap

events.label: onto bush, over its sign
events._why: the hedge's leading end only reaches the column at ~26.55; landing before that hovered over sidewalk pixels. One arc lands 26.63 on the hedge proper and clears the end sign crossing at 26.35-26.5

events.label: sign, on bush
events._why: this sign crosses the column at 27.65-27.85 (annotated as approaching at 27.36); peak centred on the crossing

events.label: sign, on bush
events._why: crossing measured 28.42-28.62; the old 28.10/0.55 arc landed exactly on the sign

events.label: car
events._why: the descent at 0.95s air still touched the car's pixels at 31.83 (SAM-confirmed); landing 32.08 is right in front of it and clear

events.label: two cars
events._why: the near black car's roof is over the old 34.0 takeoff; starting 0.15s earlier clears it, landing 35.47 annotated exact

pathAdjust._why: roll along the middle of the sidewalk, a bit in front
land parallel to the people and the bushes, not visibly behind them
land beside the parked car at 42.35, on the lot pavement next to it - the old -0.09 floated the ball above and read as behind it
grass bank at the clip end: keep the ball inside the visible region

behindSpans._why: a near pole sweeps the column at 37.2-37.5 while the ball rolls; it should pass visibly behind it
the ball passes behind the pole during this arc
rolling mid-scene: visibly behind the poles it passes

_occluderLabels_why: Cars whose base sits clearly below the ball's line are between the ball
and the camera - the parked grey car at 7.6-8.5s and the van's tall tail
at 11.0-11.3s. The ball descending past them belongs BEHIND them, and the
depth rule already knows which those are; cars at the ball's own depth
(the 31s and 34s landings) fail the margin and stay unoccluded.

frontSpans._why: the slide off the hedge happens in front of the bush and its signs - nothing may occlude it
